definitions.gloss: one-person company; sole-member corporation; single-owner business entity
definitions.explanation: A legally incorporated company where a single individual serves as the sole shareholder, director, and often the only employee. Distinct from sole proprietorship in that it is a registered corporate entity with limited liability.

examples.japanese: ⟦フリーランス→フリーランス：06152_furiiransu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I changed from freelancing to a one-person company.

examples.japanese: {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{節税|せつぜい}→節税：16469_setsuzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メリット→メリット：06848_meritto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Establishing a one-person company has tax-saving advantages.

examples.japanese: {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{社会保険|しゃかいほけん}→社会保険：18894_shakaihoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even a one-person company has the obligation to enroll in social insurance as a corporation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (one person) and ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (company). Since the 2006 revision of Japan's Companies Act, it became possible to establish a {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ} (limited liability company) or ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧ (corporation) with just one person, making {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ} increasingly common among freelancers and consultants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish a one-person company
- {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: managing a one-person company
- {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メリット→メリット：06848_meritto⟧: advantages of a one-person company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個人事業主|こじんじぎょうぬし}→個人事業主：26304_kojinjigyounushi⟧: sole proprietor — an individual running a business without incorporating
- マイクロ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: micro corporation — a very small incorporated business, often used interchangeably with {一人会社|ひとりがいしゃ}
- {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}: limited liability company (LLC) — a common corporate form chosen for one-person companies due to lower setup costs
